title: [review] provisioning.py:451: Session collision overwrites e
description: When create_br_session() is called with a peer_host that already has an active session, the old session is silently overwritten via dict assignment. The old session's cryptographic material (_prov_key, _provisioned_seed) is not wiped, leaking secrets. An attacker could also exploit this to reset a legitimate provisioning attempt mid-flight by initiating a new session for the same peer_host.
close_reason: Fixed: Both create_br_session() and create_node_session() now wipe existing sessions before overwriting. This prevents cryptographic material leakage and protects against mid-flight provisioning reset attacks.
